about: Hand-written option text for decision routers (option_text: rich). One entry per real tool id: summary replaces the upstream description, use_when / not_when separate look-alike tools, key_args names the inputs that tell them apart. Written from tool descriptions/schemas, dev-split questions and confusion counts only; no test-split question text was read.

deepwiki.ask_wiki_question.summary: Answers a natural-language question about how a public GitHub repo's code works, grounded in its DeepWiki.
deepwiki.ask_wiki_question.use_when: the user asks how/why/where something works inside a named repo (internals, design, comparisons between repos)
deepwiki.ask_wiki_question.not_when: the user wants the whole generated wiki (read_wiki_contents) or only its topic list (read_wiki_structure); a package name with no repo and a docs/API question fits context7

deepwiki.read_wiki_contents.summary: Returns the full generated DeepWiki documentation text of a GitHub repo.
deepwiki.read_wiki_contents.use_when: the user wants to read, view, open or study a repo's generated wiki/documentation itself, in full or on a broad area
deepwiki.read_wiki_contents.not_when: the user only wants the list of topics/chapter titles (read_wiki_structure) or an answer to a specific question (ask_wiki_question)

deepwiki.read_wiki_structure.summary: Returns only the table of contents (topic titles) of a repo's DeepWiki, no page text.
deepwiki.read_wiki_structure.use_when: the user asks for the topics, chapter headings, outline or table of contents, usually to choose where to start
deepwiki.read_wiki_structure.not_when: the user wants to read the documentation content (read_wiki_contents) or get an explanation (ask_wiki_question)

context7.resolve-library-id.summary: Turns a library/package name into a Context7 library ID (/org/project); the required first step before querying Context7 docs.
context7.resolve-library-id.use_when: the user wants current docs or examples for a library named in plain words (Prisma, TanStack Query, Next.js) and gives no /org/project ID
context7.resolve-library-id.not_when: the request already contains a Context7 ID like /vercel/next.js (call query-docs directly); the user needs a GitHub owner/repo for repo tools (gitmcp match_common_libs_owner_repo_mapping)

context7.query-docs.summary: Queries up-to-date docs and code examples of one library by its Context7 ID.
context7.query-docs.use_when: the request includes a Context7 library ID in /org/project or /org/project/version form, or one was just resolved
context7.query-docs.not_when: only a plain library name is given and no ID is known yet (resolve-library-id first)

aws-knowledge.aws___search_documentation.summary: Searches AWS documentation and returns verbatim page chunks that usually answer directly.
aws-knowledge.aws___search_documentation.use_when: any AWS how-to, concept, limit, error or 'what's new' question without a specific doc URL to read
aws-knowledge.aws___search_documentation.not_when: the user gives an AWS doc URL and wants the whole page or the rest of a truncated one (read_documentation); region availability of a service/API (get_regional_availability); the list of regions (list_regions)

aws-knowledge.aws___read_documentation.summary: Fetches complete AWS documentation pages (by URL) as markdown.
aws-knowledge.aws___read_documentation.use_when: a docs.aws.amazon.com URL is given or was found and the full page, a complete table/list, or the continuation of a truncated page is needed
aws-knowledge.aws___read_documentation.not_when: there is no URL yet and the user is asking a question (search_documentation)

aws-knowledge.aws___list_regions.summary: Lists all AWS regions with their codes and names.
aws-knowledge.aws___list_regions.use_when: the user wants the set or count of AWS regions, or a region code/name lookup
aws-knowledge.aws___list_regions.not_when: whether a service, feature or API is offered in a region (get_regional_availability)

aws-knowledge.aws___get_regional_availab.summary: Checks whether AWS products, APIs or CloudFormation resources are available in given regions.
aws-knowledge.aws___get_regional_availab.use_when: is service/feature/API X available (or planned) in region Y, or which of these regions support X
aws-knowledge.aws___get_regional_availab.not_when: just listing regions (list_regions) or general documentation questions (search_documentation)

aws-knowledge.aws___retrieve_skill.summary: Retrieves an AWS skill (SKILL.md workflow or a file in it) by its exact skill_name from a prior search result.
aws-knowledge.aws___retrieve_skill.use_when: the user names a specific AWS skill_name (from search results) and wants its workflow or a referenced file
aws-knowledge.aws___retrieve_skill.not_when: no skill_name is known yet (search_documentation first) or it is an ordinary docs question

microsoft-learn.microsoft_docs_search.summary: Searches official Microsoft Learn / Azure / .NET / M365 docs and returns excerpt chunks.
microsoft-learn.microsoft_docs_search.use_when: a Microsoft/Azure concept, how-to, limit or error question, with no specific Learn page URL to open
microsoft-learn.microsoft_docs_search.not_when: a learn.microsoft.com URL is given or the user wants a whole/truncated page (microsoft_docs_fetch); the user mainly wants code samples (microsoft_code_sample_search)

microsoft-learn.microsoft_code_sample_se.summary: Finds official Microsoft/Azure code snippets for an SDK, class or task.
microsoft-learn.microsoft_code_sample_se.use_when: the user wants example code or a snippet for a Microsoft/Azure SDK, API or language
microsoft-learn.microsoft_code_sample_se.not_when: conceptual or troubleshooting questions (microsoft_docs_search); reading a full page (microsoft_docs_fetch)

microsoft-learn.microsoft_docs_fetch.summary: Fetches a complete Microsoft Learn page by URL as markdown.
microsoft-learn.microsoft_docs_fetch.use_when: a learn.microsoft.com (or other Microsoft docs) URL is given, or a search result was truncated and the full article is needed
microsoft-learn.microsoft_docs_fetch.not_when: there is no page/URL yet and the user is asking a question (microsoft_docs_search)

huggingface.hf_whoami.summary: Read-only: shows which Hugging Face account and organizations the current token belongs to and what it may access.
huggingface.hf_whoami.use_when: the user asks who they are signed in as on Hugging Face, or what their token/credential can access
huggingface.hf_whoami.not_when: the user wants to change anything in their account (create/delete repos or tokens, change visibility, restart or upgrade Spaces, upload, train, run inference): no listed tool can do that

huggingface.hub_repo_search.summary: Searches the Hugging Face Hub for models, datasets or Spaces by keywords, author, tags, with sorting.
huggingface.hub_repo_search.use_when: find/discover repos matching a topic, task, author or popularity (by downloads, likes), with links
huggingface.hub_repo_search.not_when: a known hf:// path or file to list/read, trending papers or daily papers (hf_fs); details of a known repo id (hub_repo_details)
huggingface.hub_repo_search.key_args: query, repo_types, author, filters, sort, limit

huggingface.hub_repo_details.summary: Gets details of known Hugging Face repos by id: model card info, dataset structure/splits, or dataset preview rows.
huggingface.hub_repo_details.use_when: the user names a specific repo (author/name) and asks about its details, configs, splits, schema or sample rows
huggingface.hub_repo_details.not_when: discovering repos by topic (hub_repo_search); reading a raw file by hf:// path (hf_fs)

huggingface.hf_fs.summary: Filesystem-style access to the Hub via hf:// URIs: ls/cat/find/stat files, trending models, trending and daily papers, collections.
huggingface.hf_fs.use_when: an hf:// path is given, the user wants to read a specific file in a repo, or wants trending/daily papers or trending listings
huggingface.hf_fs.not_when: keyword search for repos by topic/author (hub_repo_search); structured details of a named repo (hub_repo_details)

cloudflare-docs.search_cloudflare_docume.summary: Searches Cloudflare's developer documentation (Workers, Pages, R2, KV, D1, Queues, DNS, WAF, ...).
cloudflare-docs.search_cloudflare_docume.use_when: how-to, concept, limits or configuration questions about any Cloudflare product
cloudflare-docs.search_cloudflare_docume.not_when: the request is specifically about moving a Pages project to Workers (migrate_pages_to_workers_guide); performing an action on the user's Cloudflare account (purge, deploy, DNS edit): no listed tool does that

cloudflare-docs.migrate_pages_to_workers.summary: Returns Cloudflare's guide for migrating a Pages project to Workers.
cloudflare-docs.migrate_pages_to_workers.use_when: the user is migrating or converting a Cloudflare Pages site/project to Workers

gitmcp.match_common_libs_owner_repo_mapp.summary: Maps a library name to its GitHub owner/repo.
gitmcp.match_common_libs_owner_repo_mapp.use_when: the user has only a library or package name and the GitHub owner/repo is needed before reading its repo docs or code
gitmcp.match_common_libs_owner_repo_mapp.not_when: the owner/repo is already given (use fetch_generic_documentation, search_generic_documentation or search_generic_code directly); the user wants Context7 docs for a library (context7 resolve-library-id)

gitmcp.fetch_generic_documentation.summary: Fetches the main documentation (README/docs) of a GitHub repo given owner and repo.
gitmcp.fetch_generic_documentation.use_when: owner/repo is known and the user wants the repo's own docs as a whole or an overview, with no particular topic
gitmcp.fetch_generic_documentation.not_when: a specific topic inside the docs (search_generic_documentation); source code (search_generic_code); the DeepWiki-generated wiki (deepwiki); only a library name is known (match_common_libs_owner_repo_mapping)

gitmcp.search_generic_documentation.summary: Semantic search inside one GitHub repo's documentation for a specific topic.
gitmcp.search_generic_documentation.use_when: owner/repo is known and the user wants the docs passage about a particular feature, option or concept
gitmcp.search_generic_documentation.not_when: the whole docs/overview (fetch_generic_documentation); code files (search_generic_code); only a library name is known (match_common_libs_owner_repo_mapping)

gitmcp.search_generic_code.summary: Searches source code files in a GitHub repo and returns matching files.
gitmcp.search_generic_code.use_when: the user wants to find where something is implemented or defined in a repo's code (function, class, file)

gitmcp.fetch_generic_url_content.summary: Fetches the content of an arbitrary absolute URL (respects robots.txt).
gitmcp.fetch_generic_url_content.use_when: the user gives a web URL that no vendor-specific docs reader covers and wants its content
gitmcp.fetch_generic_url_content.not_when: AWS doc URLs (aws read_documentation), Microsoft Learn URLs (microsoft_docs_fetch), hf:// paths (hf_fs), or a repo's docs by owner/repo (fetch_generic_documentation)

astro-docs.search_astro_docs.summary: Searches the official Astro framework documentation.
astro-docs.search_astro_docs.use_when: a question about how to do something in Astro (routing, content collections, islands, adapters, config)
astro-docs.search_astro_docs.not_when: the user wants an action done on their project or deployment (build, run, deploy, edit files, read logs): no listed tool does that

svelte.list-sections.summary: Lists the available Svelte 5 / SvelteKit documentation sections with their use cases; the required first step before fetching Svelte docs.
svelte.list-sections.use_when: the user wants Svelte or SvelteKit documentation on a topic and the sections have not been listed/reviewed yet, or asks which docs topics exist
svelte.list-sections.not_when: the user says the sections were already listed/reviewed or names an exact section path/title to retrieve (get-documentation); code to check (svelte-autofixer)

svelte.get-documentation.summary: Retrieves the full text of specific Svelte/SvelteKit documentation sections by title or path.
svelte.get-documentation.use_when: the section list was already reviewed, or the user names the exact section(s) or path (e.g. kit/load) to read
svelte.get-documentation.not_when: the docs index has not been listed yet (list-sections first); the user pasted component code to check (svelte-autofixer); an action on their project (run, deploy, test, install): no listed tool does that
svelte.get-documentation.key_args: section (title or path, one or many)

svelte.svelte-autofixer.summary: Analyzes Svelte component/module code and returns fixes for issues.
svelte.svelte-autofixer.use_when: the user provides Svelte code and wants it checked, validated or fixed, or Svelte code is about to be returned to the user
svelte.svelte-autofixer.not_when: the user wants documentation (list-sections / get-documentation) or a shareable REPL link for final code (playground-link)

svelte.playground-link.summary: Creates a shareable Svelte playground (online REPL) link from final component code.
svelte.playground-link.use_when: the user wants a link to run or share finished Svelte code in the browser and it is not being written into their project
svelte.playground-link.not_when: the code still needs checking (svelte-autofixer) or was written to a project file

kiwi.search-flight.summary: Searches Kiwi.com for flights between places on given dates, with prices and booking links.
kiwi.search-flight.use_when: finding or comparing flights, fares or routes for dates and passengers
kiwi.search-flight.not_when: managing an existing booking (cancel, change seats, bags, check-in, refunds), flight status, hotels, cars or loyalty points: no listed tool does that
kiwi.search-flight.key_args: flyFrom, flyTo, departureDate, returnDate, adults, cabinClass

kiwi.feedback-to-devs.summary: Sends feedback or bug reports about the Kiwi flight-search tool to its developers.
kiwi.feedback-to-devs.use_when: the user reports a problem with or suggestion for the flight search results/tool itself
kiwi.feedback-to-devs.not_when: booking management or anything other than the search tool
